caption: A phone lying on a coffee table lights up, and its glowing reflection appears in the dark television screen facing it.

sa.check: A phone lies on a coffee table.
Its glowing reflection appears in the television screen facing it.
The phone lights first and the reflection appears with it.

pc.expect: The reflection appears at the instant the phone lights and would disappear when it goes dark.
pc.fail: It appears before the phone lights; or stays after it goes dark; or the phone lights and no reflection appears.

pc.expect: Nothing appears in the screen before the phone lights, and there is one reflection.
pc.fail: A glow is in the screen before; or two reflections; or the reflection comes out of the screen.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image of the phone, dimmer.
pc.fail: It is brighter than the phone; or a different shape; or not mirrored.

pc.expect: The phone and the screen stay put.
pc.fail: The phone slides; or the screen turns; or the reflection drifts.
A second phone appears; or the television vanishes; or the phone passes into the screen.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The table and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The table changes; or the room rearranges; or the television changes.
